result.rationale: The new admin-embedding controller's saveChanges() calls `this.get('embedding').update({})` with no promise handling. The codebase elsewhere (embeddable-host component) uses `.catch(popupAjaxError)` for error feedback, so this save path silently swallows failures of the PUT /customize/embedding request, leaving the admin with no indication the save failed. This is a genuine behavior gap introduced by the diff in the new UI.
